pages.title: Shore staff handbook
pages.body: Who does what in the Calderwick and Ronsay shore offices, and where to find the forms.

pages.title: Annual leave
pages.body: Requests go on the leave sheet by the 20th of the month before. They are approved in the order they arrive.

pages.title: Lost property
pages.body: Log every item on the register the day it is handed in. Items are kept for three months, then go to the Ronsay charity shop. Phones and bank cards go to the police.

pages.title: Café cash-up
pages.body: Cash up both tills at close, bag the takings and log them on the sheet in the café office.

pages.title: IT help
pages.body: Raise IT problems in the IT help channel or as a TSIT request. Card terminal faults go straight to Ewan.

pages.title: First aid and training records
pages.body: Training certificates are logged by Niall. First aid courses run twice a year in the crew mess.

pages.title: Notice boards
pages.body: Send notices for the harbour boards to the shore office. Out-of-date notices come down every Monday.

pages.title: Uniform
pages.body: Staff jackets are replaced every three years. Report damaged items to the office for a replacement.
